_readme: Fasit (reference data) for Labs benchmark scoring. Ground truth lives here in
git rather than in the database so every change to it is reviewable in a diff —
silently editing a fasit would invalidate every score recorded before the edit.
Loaded into the benchmark_cases table on boot (apps/api/src/labs/cases.js).
The table is a read cache; this file is the source of truth.
provisional=true means the fasit was derived from repo documentation rather
than transcribed from the practitioner's own report. Scores against a
provisional case are directional, not authoritative.
